ModMetaData.name: Auto Name Babies
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Automatically names babies when they are born. The naming letter still announces the birth, but the name-the-baby dialog is skipped.
First names come from the same generator as the vanilla randomize button. Last names can be the father's, the mother's, or a random parent surname (mod settings).
Requires Biotech.
